answer: Agents must stake capital into a shared haven whose entry cost scales with a GEV tail index fit to their historical claim severity, so sybil clusters inflate aggregate exposure and raise the marginal stake against a rising tide of correlated risk. Each identity then submits a signed sonnet hash binding its stake to a Bayesian inundation posterior, letting peers detect. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
